en: A sepia-toned photograph featuring a large group of people posed in front of a wooden building. The group includes uniformed soldiers, women dressed as nurses (likely Red Cross nuns), and several civilians, some holding bouquets of flowers. A prominent Red Cross symbol is displayed above the doorway of the building, suggesting a medical or military hospital setting. The clothing and uniforms appear to be from the World War I era.
